ann.t: Press Release — Oriental Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 15, 2026, titled "OHL ANNOUNCES Q2 AND H1 FY 2026-2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Oriental Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Oriental Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Oriental Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
